# [TASK] Wire the five remaining services to the config server in the Docker profile

## Task
Five services declare `SPRING_CONFIG_IMPORT: optional:configserver:...` in
docker-compose and wait on config-service's healthcheck, but none of them has
`spring-cloud-starter-config` on the classpath: api-gateway, user-service,
actor-service, ai-service, media-service. Without that library Spring cannot
resolve the `configserver:` prefix, and the `optional:` prefix makes it skip
silently. They take all their settings from compose environment variables.

movie-service is the only one wired correctly and is the pattern to copy.

## Scope
Docker profile only. Kubernetes must stay exactly as it is — config-service is
deliberately not deployed there (ADR-005).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The five services carry `spring-cloud-starter-config` and declare `spring.config.import`, matching movie-service
- [x] Each service starts and reads its configuration from config-service under docker compose
- [x] The Kubernetes overlays render unchanged apart from an explicit opt-out, and services still start with no config server reachable
- [x] `./gradlew build` is green across the backend

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3

## Notes
Verified: all five services carry `spring-cloud-starter-config` in their `build.gradle`.
